title: Unit 1 Section B (2a - Reflecting) 课时练习

sections.title: 一、根据句意及汉语提示写出单词
sections.instruction: 根据句意及汉语提示，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳单词。

questions.prompt: 1. Next week is very ______ (忙的) for me. I can't play with you.
questions.translation: 下周对我来说非常忙碌。我不能和你一起玩了。
questions.explanation: 根据汉语提示“忙的”，英文为形容词busy。故选 busy。

questions.prompt: 2. We are from Class 2 and we are ______ (同班同学).
questions.translation: 我们来自二班，我们是同班同学。
questions.explanation: 主语为we，表语“同班同学”需用复数形式classmates。故选 classmates。

questions.prompt: 3. It's cold here ______ (甚至) in summer.
questions.translation: 这里甚至在夏天都很冷。
questions.explanation: 根据汉语提示“甚至”，英文副词为even。故选 even。

questions.prompt: 4. ______ (每一个) student in our class likes our head teacher.
questions.translation: 我们班的每一个学生都喜欢我们的班主任。
questions.explanation: 句首单词首字母大写。修饰单数可数名词student并强调每一个个体，用Each（或Every）。选项中Each符合题意。故选 Each。

questions.prompt: 5. I want to know some ______ (信息) about you.
questions.translation: 我想了解一些关于你的信息。
questions.explanation: “信息”为不可数名词information，没有复数形式。故选 information。

sections.title: 二、在空白处填入适当的词或用括号中所给单词的适当形式填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下列句子，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳答案填入空白处。

questions.prompt: 1. Getting to know each other is the first step in ______ (make) new friends.
questions.translation: 互相了解是结交新朋友的第一步。
questions.explanation: 介词in后接动词时需用动名词形式making。故选 making。

questions.prompt: 2. What are your ______ (hobby)?
questions.translation: 你的业余爱好是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据系动词are可知主语应用复数形式，hobby的复数形式为改y为i加es，即hobbies。故选 hobbies。

questions.prompt: 3. The students in our class are from different ______ (country).
questions.translation: 我们班的学生来自不同的国家。
questions.explanation: different修饰可数名词复数，country的复数形式为countries。故选 countries。

questions.prompt: 4. Students often make a ______ (mistake) in greeting others.
questions.translation: 学生们在向他人问候时经常犯错误。
questions.explanation: 不定冠词a后接可数名词单数mistake；make a mistake为固定短语，意为“犯错误”。故选 mistake。

questions.prompt: 5. Who ______ (be) in the school band?
questions.translation: 谁在学校乐队里？
questions.explanation: 疑问代词Who作主语且单复数不明确时，谓语动词通常用第三人称单数形式is。故选 is。

questions.prompt: 6. I ______ (be) from China and I can speak English very well.
questions.translation: 我来自中国，而且我英语说得很好。
questions.explanation: 第一人称单数I作主语，一般现在时系动词be用am。故选 am。

questions.prompt: 7. You ______ (be) in Class 1, Grade 7 and we are in the same class.
questions.translation: 你在七年级一班，我们在同一个班级。
questions.explanation: 第二人称代词You作主语，一般现在时系动词be用are。故选 are。

questions.prompt: 8. Do you want to make friends with me? Please write ______ me.
questions.translation: 你想和我交朋友吗？请给我写信。
questions.explanation: write to sb. 为固定搭配，意为“给某人写信”。故选 to。

questions.prompt: 9. We often play basketball ______ school.
questions.translation: 我们经常放学后打篮球。
questions.explanation: after school 为固定介词短语，意为“放学后”。故选 after。

sections.title: 三、选择正确的单词或短语完成句子
sections.instruction: 从每小题括号中所给的两个选项中选出正确的单词或短语完成句子。

questions.prompt: 1. Do you ______ (want; would like) to be my friend?
questions.translation: 你想成为我的朋友吗？
questions.explanation: 疑问句由助动词Do引导，动词应用want（Do you want to...？）；而would like的一般疑问句通常直接将情态动词Would提前（Would you like to...？）。故选 want。

questions.prompt: 2. Lisa Wood is my full name. Lisa is my ______ (first name; last name).
questions.translation: 莉萨·伍德是我的全名。莉萨是我的名字。
questions.explanation: 英文姓名中名在前、姓在后，Lisa是名（first name），Wood是姓（last name）。故选 first name。

questions.prompt: 3. Liu Xin is my new friend. Liu is his ______ (first name; last name).
questions.translation: 刘新是我的新朋友。刘是他的姓氏。
questions.explanation: 中国姓名中姓在前、名在后，Liu是姓氏（last name/family name）。故选 last name。

questions.prompt: 4. His favourite sport is tennis, so he likes playing tennis ______ (a lot; very).
questions.translation: 他最喜爱的运动是网球，因此他非常喜欢打网球。
questions.explanation: a lot 可用作副词短语修饰动词短语 likes playing tennis，表示程度“非常”；very不能单独修饰动词，需用very much。故选 a lot。

questions.prompt: 5. Sally is from Singapore. She ______ (speaks; says) both English and Chinese.
questions.translation: 萨莉来自新加坡。她既会说英语也会说中文。
questions.explanation: 表示讲某种语言用动词speak，主语She为第三人称单数，用speaks；say通常表示说话的具体内容。故选 speaks。

questions.prompt:
6. —How ______ (is; are) your parents?
—They are good.
questions.translation:
——你父母身体好吗？
——他们挺好的。
questions.explanation: 问句主语your parents为复数概念（父母双亲），系动词be用are。故选 are。

questions.prompt: 7. My uncle has many things on the farm. Some are plants; ______ (others; another) are animals.
questions.translation: 我叔叔在农场有许多东西。有些是植物，有些是动物。
questions.explanation: 固定句型“Some ... others ...”表示“一些……，另一些……”，others作复数代词代指其他东西。故选 others。

sections.title: 四、连词成句
sections.instruction: 将所给词语连成一句话，注意大小写和标点符号。

questions.prompt: make, to, you, friends, with, want, do, me, (?)
questions.answer: Do you want to make friends with me?
questions.translation: 你想和我交朋友吗？
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句：助动词“Do” + 主语“you” + 动词短语“want to make friends with me”，句末用问号。

questions.prompt: both, tennis, like, playing, of, us, (.)
questions.answer: Both of us like playing tennis.
questions.translation: 我们两个都喜欢打网球。
questions.explanation: 主谓宾句型：主语“Both of us” + 谓语动词“like” + 动名词短语“playing tennis”，句末用句号。

questions.prompt: is, Mapo tofu, favourite, Tom's, food, (.)
questions.answer: Tom's favourite food is Mapo tofu.
questions.translation: 汤姆最喜欢的食物是麻婆豆腐。
questions.explanation: 主系表结构：主语“Tom's favourite food” + 系动词“is” + 表语“Mapo tofu”，句末用句号。

questions.prompt: are, playing, his, hobbies, guitar, and, the, reading, (.)
questions.answer: His hobbies are playing the guitar and reading.
questions.translation: 他的爱好是弹吉他和读书。
questions.explanation: 主系表结构：主语“His hobbies” + 系动词“are” + 并列动名词表语“playing the guitar and reading”，句末用句号。

questions.prompt: we, know, each, other, how, should, (?)
questions.answer: How should we know each other?
questions.translation: 我们应该怎么了解彼此？
questions.explanation: 特殊疑问句：疑问代词“How” + 情态动词“should” + 主语“we” + 动词短语“know each other”，句末用问号。

sections.title: 五、阅读理解
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Hello! My name is Ben and I'm thirteen years old. I have a happy family. My mother's name is Judy and she comes from Canada. My father is from America. You can call him Bob. I have a brother too. His name is Tim and he is eleven years old. Oh, Coco is a white dog. It is only two years old, and it's in my family too. And now, my family live in Xiamen, China.

My family have different eating habits. My father likes eating chicken and eggs, but my mother loves vegetables. She likes tomatoes and carrots very much. What about my brother and me? Well, bread and milk are our favourite.

My family have the same hobby. We all like doing sports. My parents always play sports with my brother and me in the morning. We can get much fun from it. We have dinner at 6:00 every evening. After that, my parents and Tim like to watch TV, but I like to read books.

questions.prompt: 1. How many people are there in Ben's family?
questions.translation: 本的家里有多少人？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段可知，本家里的人包括：Ben、母亲Judy、父亲Bob、弟弟Tim，共4人（狗Coco是宠物，不是人）。故选 Four.。

questions.prompt: 2. What food does Judy like?
questions.translation: 朱迪喜欢什么食物？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“...my mother loves vegetables. She likes tomatoes and carrots very much.”可知，母亲Judy喜欢西红柿和胡萝卜。故选 Tomatoes.。

questions.prompt: 3. What does Ben think of doing sports?
questions.translation: 本觉得做运动怎么样？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“We all like doing sports... We can get much fun from it.”可知，他们能从运动中获得很多乐趣，说明他觉得运动很有趣（Interesting）。故选 Interesting.。

questions.prompt: 4. What does Ben do in the evening?
questions.translation: 本在晚上做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段最后一句“After that, my parents and Tim like to watch TV, but I like to read books.”可知，本晚上喜欢看书（He reads books.）。故选 He reads books.。

sections.title: 六、完形填空
sections.instruction: 通读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Good morning! My name is Dong Ming. I am [1] from XinHua Middle School. I'm [2] Class 3, Grade 7. This is my classroom. It is [3], not too cold in autumn or winter. There are forty chairs and forty desks in the classroom.

We have many classes every day and I like English very much. Miss Wu is [4] English teacher. Her English [5] is Betty. She often [6] us with our English. She always asks us to [7] English in her class. I have a new friend and [8] name is Nick. He is in Class 3 too. We often play football after school, because football is our favourite [9]. This is my [10] life here. I like my new school very much!

questions.translation: 我是新华中学的一名学生。
questions.explanation: 根据后文介绍在七年级三班及课堂生活可知，Dong Ming是一名学生（student）。故选 student。

questions.translation: 我在七年级三班。
questions.explanation: 在某个班级用介词in，即in Class 3, Grade 7。故选 in。

questions.translation: 它很温暖，在秋天或冬天都不太冷。
questions.explanation: 根据后半句“not too cold in autumn or winter”可知教室很暖和（warm）。故选 warm。

questions.translation: 吴老师是我们的英语老师。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词短语English teacher需用形容词性物主代词our（我们的）。故选 our。

questions.translation: 她的英文名字叫贝蒂。
questions.explanation: Betty是一个女性英文名字，故此处指English name（英文名字）。故选 name。

questions.translation: 她经常在英语方面帮助我们。
questions.explanation: help sb. with sth. 为固定搭配，意为“在某方面帮助某人”。主语She为单数第三人称，动词用helps。故选 helps。

questions.translation: 她总是要求我们在她的课上说英语。
questions.explanation: 表示讲某种语言用动词speak，speak English意为“讲英语”。故选 speak。

questions.translation: 我有一个新朋友，他的名字叫尼克。
questions.explanation: Nick为男性名字，且后句提到“He is in Class 3 too”，修饰name用形容词性物主代词his。故选 his。

questions.translation: 因为足球是我们最喜爱的运动。
questions.explanation: football属于体育运动（sport）。故选 sport。

questions.translation: 这就是我在这里的新生活。
questions.explanation: 作者刚升入初中七年级，结合末句“I like my new school very much!”可知此处指“新生活”（new life）。故选 new。

sections.title: 七、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，在空白处填入1个适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。
sections.passage: Alice is a middle school student. She has two good [1] (friend), Helen and Paul. They are in [2] same class. They both [3] (speak) English well. And they like English a lot. Alice [4] (like) music too. She plays the guitar [5]. She is [6] the school music band. Helen doesn't like music. She can't play the guitar [7] she likes doing sports. [8] (she) favourite sport is tennis. She often plays sports with her friends after school. Paul likes both music and sports. He has many [9] (hobby). Paul's favourite food is noodles. Would you like [10] (make) friends with them?

questions.prompt: 1. friend
questions.translation: 她有两个好朋友，海伦和保罗。
questions.explanation: 基数词two后接可数名词复数friends。故选 friends。

questions.translation: 他们在同一个班级。
questions.explanation: the same class 为固定搭配，same前习惯加定冠词the。故选 the。

questions.prompt: 3. speak
questions.translation: 他们两个人英语都说得很好。
questions.explanation: 主语They both为复数，一般现在时谓语动词用原形speak。故选 speak。

questions.prompt: 4. like
questions.translation: 爱丽丝也喜欢音乐。
questions.explanation: 主语Alice为第三人称单数，一般现在时动词like需加s变为likes。故选 likes。

questions.translation: 她吉他弹得很好。
questions.explanation: 修饰动词短语plays the guitar应用副词well（好地）。故选 well。

questions.translation: 她在学校音乐乐队里。
questions.explanation: 在乐队里用介词in，即in the school music band。故选 in。

questions.translation: 她不会弹吉他，但是她喜欢做运动。
questions.explanation: 前句“不会弹吉他”与后句“喜欢做运动”存在转折对比关系，用连词but。故选 but。

questions.prompt: 8. she
questions.translation: 她最喜爱的运动是网球。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词短语favourite sport需用形容词性物主代词Her，句首首字母大写。故选 Her。

questions.prompt: 9. hobby
questions.translation: 他有许多业余爱好。
questions.explanation: many后接可数名词复数，hobby以辅音字母加y结尾，改y为i加es变为hobbies。故选 hobbies。

questions.prompt: 10. make
questions.translation: 你想和他们交朋友吗？
questions.explanation: would like to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“想要做某事”，后接动词不定式to make。故选 to make。
